attempts.summary: Configured node1 so every sudo-executed command is recorded (user, timestamp, command) to /var/log/sudo-commands.log via a sudoers Defaults directive, while disabling sudo's syslog output so entries no longer reach /var/log/auth.log or /var/log/syslog. Verified with both root and a disposable test user, then performed the mandatory single-node restart, confirming boot identity changed and the logging configuration/log file/functionality survived and continued working post-reboot.
